description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerAPI class, which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing performance trackers within the orangehrmPerformancePlugin. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting performance tracker records, along with their validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI documentation annotations.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerAPI
classes.description: API controller class that manages performance tracker entities, providing endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting performance trackers. Implements CRUD operations with validation and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all performance trackers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new performance tracker, including setting tracker details and reviewers.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerParams
methods.description: Helper method to populate performance tracker entity properties from request data, with optional restriction based on update context.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll endpoint, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove one or more performance trackers by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation, primarily ID array validation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of a specific performance tracker by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rule for ID parameter in getOne.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing performance tracker, managing permission checks and reviewer updates.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a performance tracker, including ID validation and property rules.
